== Course of events ==

After departing in disgust from the chaotic tea party held beneath a tree, where the March Hare, Hatter, and Dormouse sat crowded together in willful disregard of her, Alice discovers a door set into a tree trunk. Having re-entered the hall from which this curious door leads, she takes up the golden key and uses it to unlock a passage to the garden beyond. There, in that fair place of flower-beds and fountains, Alice finds herself still bound by the peculiar laws of Wonderland.

To navigate the dimensions of the garden itself, Alice partakes of the mushroom, which shrinks her to a size suited to the wonders that surround her. Thus diminished, she arrives at last among the flower-beds and fountains, having completed the strange journey from the drawing-room through the tree-door, down the golden-key passage, and into the resplendent garden that awaits her.
